topic.title: Creating an Independent Review Task
topic.shortdesc: Create a review task from the browser interface, add or upload files, and then continue with sharing and task setup.

body.p: Both Subject-Matter Experts and Authors can create an Independent Review Task in the browser interface.
After you create the task, you can create new files in it or upload files to it.
To create a review task and add files:

ol.li: On the My Review Tasks page, click New Task.
Enter a title for the task in the field at the top of the pane, then click the check mark.
Add files to the task. To create a file, click New File, select a template, enter a title, and click OK. To upload a file, click Upload and select the file from your system.

Open the new file in the Visual Editor page if it is not already open, and make your changes.As a task owner, you can always control the Toggle Change Tracking toolbar option. You may want to turn change tracking off when you add initial content to a new file.
Optional: In the left stripe, click Settings to open the Task Settings page and configure task options.
When the task is ready, share the task with reviewers.
